description: This Java class represents the 'OrderProduct' entity within an e-commerce system, mapping to the 'ORDER_PRODUCT' table. It models products within an order, including attributes such as SKU, product name, quantity, charges, and associated attributes, prices, and downloads.

classes.name: OrderProduct
classes.description: Entity class representing a product included in a customer's order, with fields for SKU, name, quantity, charges, and relationships to order attributes, prices, and downloads.

methods.name: OrderProduct
methods.description: Default constructor for the OrderProduct entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order product.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order product.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the product.

methods.name: setProductName
methods.description: Sets the name of the product.

methods.name: getProductQuantity
methods.description: Retrieves the quantity of the product ordered.

methods.name: setProductQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product ordered.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates the order product with a specific order.

methods.name: getOrderAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the set of attributes associated with this order product.

methods.name: setOrderAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes for this order product.

methods.name: getPrices
methods.description: Retrieves the set of prices related to this order product.

methods.name: setPrices
methods.description: Sets the prices for this order product.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Retrieves the set of downloadable items related to this order product.

methods.name: setDownloads
methods.description: Sets the downloadable items for this order product.

methods.name: setSku
methods.description: Sets the SKU (stock keeping unit) for the product.

methods.name: getSku
methods.description: Retrieves the SKU for the product.

methods.name: setOneTimeCharge
methods.description: Sets the one-time charge associated with this product.

methods.name: getOneTimeCharge
methods.description: Retrieves the one-time charge amount for the product.
